title: His and hers Datsuns: Wrenching keeps this marriage finely tuned | Why I Drive  #6
description:
With a love that was forged over the brakes on a 1992 Cadillac DeVille in high school shop class, Courtney and Dustin Frisk have made wrenching and driving a cornerstone of their car-loving marriage. Their wedding car was Courtney's 1973 Datsun 240Z, and the Japanese bug hasn't let go—Dustin owns a '72 Datsun 510 with an engine swap from a 240SX and a differential from a Subaru WRX STI. And while most couples' dinner chat is about the latest Netflix shows and updating the grocery list, the Frisks can't help but talk shop. Whether it's which new sway bars to buy or when they can next take a weekend joy ride to Skyline Drive high above California's Silicon Valley, Courtney and Dustin are living the romantic gearhead dream.

title: Chivalric Valor / Valoric Fire
description:

Materials copyrighted; if quoting, please properly credit Alpha Affirmations.

Support the channel: https://www.buymeacoffee.com/affirmations 

Script:
Chivalric valor, the essence of a knight
It is the gallantry, that drives us to fight
A virtue, held dear and true
The strength, that sees us through
It is the heart, that beats with noble intent
It is the honor, the excellence, heaven sent
The soul that seeks to do right
The brilliant fire burning bright
May we strive to live up to our standards high
Strength, honor, and fire we personify.
Valoric fire, the flame within our hearts
It is the essence that sets us apart
That drive to be valiant and true
The bravery, the heroism, of the superior few
It is the spark, luminous in our soul
It is the spiritual light that makes us whole
That drive impelling us forward
The light calling us upward
Valoric fire, more than a flame
It is the lineage of light, that gives us our name
A force to be glorified
Among a golden sun and azure sky
So let us cultivate the valoric fire within
As light warriors, much more than men
And let it burn bright with all its might
For we lonesome warriors of the demigod Light.
